slides.title: Two expressions are identical. Find ==a + b==.

slides.stem: The expression 3(2x² + ax) − 2(x² + x − b) is equivalent to 4x² + 16x + 6 for all values of x, where a and b are constants. What is the value of a + b?
slides.prompt: Time yourself. Comment your time and your answer.

slides.title: C — 9
slides.body: Expand to 4x² + (3a − 2)x + 2b. Most students pick A (3): mishandles the constant sign, solving −2b = 6 to get b = −3, then a + b = 6 + (−3) = 3.

slides.title: Match Coefficients of Equivalent Polynomials
slides.body: "Equivalent for all x" means the two polynomials match term by term. Match each coefficient column separately (x², x, constant), and watch how distribution multiplies the unknown — here the constant is 2b, not b.
